items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: But I had old man Glenn in my band for years.

ctx.x: I never heard of Piku. You see, I live around Piku House all my days. I never heard of that until at that one meeting. That was around, way around 49, 48. When I heard Piku said, hero, that's very, he doesn't know. Oh, somebody told me what. Because I heard Piku playing counter before I started. Long before I started. Piku, like my mum, has been in his eighties. Long before I started. And Piku was a man. I was a boy. That's why I'm telling you. And he was around here playing with old man Glenn in them.
